label: Recurring property levy: housing fee (% of annual rent)
source: Dubai Land Department FAQ (dubailand.gov.ae/en/frequently-asked-questions): "a municipality tax of 5% of the annual rent, which is shown separately in your electricity bill". Transfer fee: DLD e-service page states seller 2% + purchaser 2% of sale value.
note: Dubai levies no annual property tax on home value. The only recurring property levy is the Dubai Municipality housing fee of 5% of annual rent (billed monthly via DEWA). A one-off 4% DLD transfer fee applies at purchase.
